data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate income and provide long term capital appreciation by investing ininstruments across multiple asset classes namely Equity & Equity Related Instruments, Debt & Money Market Securities andGold/Silver related instruments. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the objectives of the scheme will berealized and the scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
